rendered:
The paper "Perspectives on the relationship between materials chemistry and roll-to-roll electrode manufacturing for high-energy lithium-ion batteries" by D.L. Wood III et al. (page 9) measured the residual moisture of water-processed and NMP-processed NMC532 cathodes.

The values at 20 °C were:
- Water-processed NMC532 cathode: 625 ppm
- NMP-processed NMC532 cathode: 200 ppm

prompt.system: You answer questions using only the documents below: pages selected from them, with tables written row by row. Answer briefly. If you compute a number, show the calculation. If the question assumes something the documents contradict, say so. If the documents do not hold the answer, say so.

expect: ensm-2020 (roll-to-roll manufacturing perspective): 625 ppm (water) and 200 ppm (NMP) at 20 °C (p8.L53-55)
